down: Rusty Manners: −1 Charisma, Implication and Authority. If anyone asks about your weapon, you tell them, at length.

traits.name: Pain Eater
traits.flavour: Pain is the only thing that makes you sharp. Theirs or yours, it doesn't matter.
up: Bloodied: while you're below half HP, +50% damage.
down: Fresh: while you're above half HP, +50% damage taken.

traits.name: Bottle Butts for Eyes
traits.flavour: Four-eyes, bookworm, glass-jaw. You've been called a lot of names, most of them accurate, but they didn't have to say it out loud.
up: Well-Read: +2 Rumination; start with [Prescription Glasses]. While wearing them, +1 Proficiency and Ingenuity.
down: Glasses Off: without them, −4 Proficiency and Ingenuity.

traits.name: The Mask
traits.flavour: Bare-faced, nobody looks at you twice. Put the mask on and the street parts for you.
up: Behind the Mask: start with a [Smiling Mask]. While masked, +2 Composure and Authority.
down: Bare Face: unmasked, −3 Composure and Authority.
Two Faces: people who met you masked don't recognise you unmasked, and the other way round.

traits.name: Machine-Faced
traits.flavour: You bought a new face at a back-alley clinic in Central City. It was a robot clinic. Nobody told the surgeon you weren't a robot.
up: Blank Face: every Composure check in dialogue succeeds. Robots and machines treat you as one of their own.
down: Uncanny: you can't use Implication or Charisma in dialogue (their combat perks still work), and children and animals panic around you.

traits.name: Right of Way
traits.flavour: Central City's streets don't move aside for anyone, and neither do you. Your limp has been there since the old injury; you just walk through it.
up: I'm Walking Here: against anyone who blocks your path or interrupts you, +2 Intimidation and Authority. You can't be moved by Shove.
down: Old Injury: −0.5 Movement, −2 Reaction Speed.

traits.name: Drill Echo
traits.flavour: Ten years ago you passed the academy's endurance drill with the best time in your cohort. The announcer's voice never stopped counting in your head.
up: Best Time: the Sprint action costs 1 AP less, and running, climbing and endurance checks can't roll below 10.
down: The Count: whenever you concentrate (drawing a Sigil, a Brain Power or Rumination check), roll a d6. On a 1 the count starts again, and you lose the action.

traits.name: The Old Blood
traits.flavour: You distrust anything unusual. You're conservative, and you don't want anything to change. Your own blood first, and only.
up: Bloodline: +2 Rumination and Guts. Among people of your own race and homeworld, +2 Authority.
down: Prejudice: with people of any other race, +2 Intimidation but −2 Charisma, Authority and Lore Master. Heals and Blessings from them work at half power on you, and you buy from them at +20% and sell to them at −20%.

traits.name: Holo-Drama Addict
traits.flavour: Three days without food, or three days without a holo-drama? You'd live on water.
up: Dramatic Timing: once per scene, describe your action as a scene from a holo-drama. If the Narrator buys the drama, roll with +3.
down: Leading Role: anything unglamorous (crawling through sewage, hiding in a bin) takes a Visualization check first: you have to picture it as a scene worth filming. On a fail you refuse, or do it at −3.

traits.name: Oil in My Mind
traits.flavour: Oil paint runs through the vessels of your brain. Give you a glass of wine and you could argue technique with Rémy Étienne or Master Sakamoto all night.
up: Canvas: read any artwork, mural, graffiti or designed object to learn who made it, how, and where it came from. +1 Visualization, Analysis and Rumination.
down: Paper: −1 Durability, Pain Threshold and Sensory. With both Oil traits, this penalty applies once.

traits.name: Oil in My Soul
traits.flavour: You don't know the technique. You know exactly how the painter felt.
up: Canvas: read any artwork to learn the maker's emotional state and intent. +1 Empathy, Camaraderie and Implication.
down: Still Paper: −1 Durability, Pain Threshold and Sensory. With both Oil traits, this penalty applies once.

traits.name: Lunarshine
traits.flavour: Part gentleman, part lush. A glass of Mandestra vintage, or the whole jug of lowland rotgut?
up: Tipsy (1 drink): +1 Camaraderie, Lore Master and Authority.
Drunk (3 drinks): a further +1 to those, plus Intimidation, Guts and Durability.
down: Wasted (5 drinks): −2 Reaction Speed, Dexterity, Proficiency, Vigilant, Analysis and Visualization.

The Slope: drinks wear off at the end of each scene. When a scene ends with you Drunk, make a Will Power check (target 12 + drinks today); on a fail you keep drinking, one step closer to Wasted. A day with no drink at all gives you the shakes: −1 Camaraderie, Authority and Composure.

traits.name: Heavyworlder
traits.flavour: Born on a high-gravity world. Your mother has never forgiven you, the bullies at school never forgot you, and doorframes still don't fit you.
up: Dense: you count as one size larger. You can't be Shoved, your carry weight doubles, you wield heavy weapons one-handed, and you get +2 Intimidation.
down: Too Big: −3 Athletics and −0.5 Movement. Attacks against you get +2 to hit. You can't hide in light, you eat double rations, and vents, crawlspaces, small doors, lifts and light vehicles can't take you.

traits.name: Born Performer
traits.flavour: Every conversation is a stage, and you've never once been yourself on it. The world may not understand you, but you understand the world.
up: Adaptable: at the start of each scene, pick one γ skill: +2 to it for the scene. +20% XP from combat.
down: Hollow: conversation never gives you XP, and anyone using Empathy on you gets +2: they sense nobody is home.

traits.name: Rabbit's Foot
traits.flavour: Half-Lapin by blood, or just someone who carries a rabbit's-foot charm. Either way, luck follows you, and so do the hunters.
up: Lucky Foot: once per session, force a reroll of any d20 that targets you.
Vengeful: when an ally is downed, your next turn has +2 AP.
down: Prey: −1 Guts, Intimidation and Authority. Hunters and Orks deal +25% damage to you, and Take the Hit or taunts can't pull their attacks off you.

traits.name: Ghost Soldier
traits.flavour: You fought in a war the records say never happened. The arm is new. The habits aren't.
up: Unseen: your first attack from stealth each combat does +50% damage and makes no sound. Start with a prosthetic arm that Proficiency can modify.
down: The War Never Ended: resting in a settlement takes a Vigilant check, or you spend the night watching the doors and get no benefit. When your stealth is broken, you lose 2 AP on your next turn. −1 Eloquence, Charisma, Implication and Composure.

traits.name: Symbol of Order
traits.flavour: The law is the only wall between the Thousand-Planet City and the dark. You are a stone in that wall.
up: I Am the Law: Karma starts locked to LAWFUL. Once per scene, when you invoke law or rank, an official must answer one question truthfully.
down: My Way: leaving Lawful costs double Karma, and every unlawful act you commit costs double Karma too.

traits.name: Rogue Element
traits.flavour: Plans, permits, chains of command: all of them break the same way, if you push hard enough.
up: Spanner in the Works: Karma starts locked to CHAOTIC. Once per scene, when you wreck someone's plan or property, gain 1 Echo.
down: My Way: leaving Chaotic costs double Karma. Lawful factions start hostile to you.

traits.name: The Soundscape of the Soul
traits.flavour: Gentle as a ripple, violent as a flood in the wet season, deep enough to drown your whole soul in.
up: Vibing: while your song plays, +1 to every Soul skill.
down: Lost the Vibe: silent too long, −1 to every Mind and Body skill.

traits.name: Headbanger
traits.flavour: The bass hits harder than a .700 Blackpoint round, and you want it louder.
up: Banger: while your song plays, +1 to every Body skill.
down: Losing It: silent too long, −1 to every Mind and Soul skill.

traits.name: Underground Sound
traits.flavour: Music while you sleep, cook, drive, even while you're listening to other music. And this band is criminally underrated.
up: Brain Dancing: while your song plays, +1 to every Mind skill.
down: Dead Air: silent too long, −1 to every Body and Soul skill.

traits.name: Worldline Fracture
traits.flavour: The worldlines are merging. Things that shouldn't exist walk your streets, and nobody else seems to notice.
up: Wild: the strangest, most impossible events show up in your campaign.
down: Unravelling: those events replace the normal events of that area.

traits.name: Factory Made
traits.flavour: Oil for blood, a plug for a gender, and a serial number for a name. The Factory built you to be spent. You weren't.
up: Machine Body: immune to poison, bleed and suffocation. Proficiency's Field Repair restores your HP, at 10 per Proficiency rank.
down: Plug: heals and Blessings work at half power on you, lightning and EMP deal double, and some humans won't talk to a machine.

traits.name: Lowland Born
traits.flavour: You grew up in the dead-building forest past the desert, Black Scavenger country, where every corner is an ambush.
up: Concrete Forest: in ruins and dense urban terrain, +1 Movement, and you always know one way out.
down: Open Sky: in open terrain, −2 Vigilant and half Detection Range.

traits.name: Central City Kid
traits.flavour: Bank cards, shock batons, and somebody else to do the dirty work. Outside the walls, nobody is impressed.
up: Plugged In: start with a city ID and a bank card. +2 on social rolls with officials and merchants; city services are open to you.
down: Soft Hands: the first time you're wounded in each combat, lose 2 AP from shock. Outside the city, −2 Guts.

traits.name: Daggerfall Veteran
traits.flavour: You were there. You remember what the speeches left out.
up: I Was There: you're immune to Fear, and once per combat you can shake off any Heart Debuff for free. +2 Authority and Composure with anyone military. Once per session, ask the Narrator how an enemy force will move next: you've seen it before.
down: Flashback: shelling, burning, or a Crawler child: Composure check (target 12) or lose your next turn.

traits.name: Upper-Touched
traits.flavour: You were born too close to the veil, and your twin soul in the upper realm talks back.
up: Thin Veil: Outbursts cost 20% less mana, and you sense upper-realm beings within 10 tiles.
down: Seen From Above: upper-realm beings always know where you are. Blessings cast on you roll a d6 for a side effect.

traits.name: Raised by Orks
traits.flavour: Your first word was a war-cry. Your second was the name of a weapon.
up: Ork Steel: +20% damage with melee weapons. Orks will parley with you instead of attacking.
down: Can't Read: you can't use written documents, maps or text-based Rumination. Humans who know your history start at −2 Charisma; other squad members choose whether this applies to them.

traits.name: Gun Nut
traits.flavour: You can name the rifle from its echo and the factory from its casing.
up: Know Your Iron: identify any firearm or round by its sound or casing: calibre, maker, where it was issued. Every gun you own gets +1 mod slot, and clearing a jam costs 0 AP.
down: Collector: the first 3 guns you get are your collection (your kit's gun counts), and you carry them, weight included. Selling, abandoning or giving away one of them takes a Dexterity check: the gun hand has to let go; on a fail, you can't part with it until your next rest. You sell every gun at −50%: you never really want to let go.

traits.name: Old School
traits.flavour: The drifter's creed: identify, squeeze, breathe the powder smoke, dig the grave.
up: Fan the Hammer: with a revolver or lever gun, fire every remaining round in one 3 AP action, at −2 to hit per shot.
down: Analog: no smart optics, Evoker-linked guns or electronic sights.

traits.name: Spray and Pray
traits.flavour: The Hellraiser doctrine: volume of fire is a tactic.
up: Suppression: a full-auto burst leaves every target in its cone Suppressed, hit or miss (a Body save; it doesn't stack): −1 AP next turn and no reactions or Overwatch. Your full-auto penalty is −1 instead of −2.
down: Ammo Hog: you burn double ammo, every round, and aimed shots are at −2.

traits.name: One Shot
traits.flavour: Breathe out. Squeeze. Don't look away.
up: Breath Held: if you haven't moved this turn, your first shot ignores cover and does +50% Critical Damage.
down: Tunnel Vision: until your next move, you can't make Vigilant checks, and ambushes against you do +50% damage.

traits.name: Sigil Savant
traits.flavour: Twenty years at the Science Team bench, and one Sigil you can draw in your sleep.
up: Muscle Memory: choose one Sigil word. Its glyph always costs 0 Core and 1 AP less.
down: Rigid: you can only draw Sigils you practised during your last rest; nothing new mid-mission.

traits.name: Hollow Heart
traits.flavour: A Mana Short left a hole in your chest. The fear went out through it.
up: Hollow: a Mana Short can't kill you; you fall unconscious instead. +10% Outburst Damage.
down: Echo Chamber: every Outburst you cast is loud. Every enemy within 10 tiles learns where you are, and you can't be in stealth on a turn you cast.

traits.name: Heretic
traits.flavour: You learned to call down a Blessing without kneeling to anyone. The saints noticed.
up: Stolen Fire: you can use Blessings without Faith. Your Blessing Power runs on Will Power instead.
down: Excommunicated: every faith-based faction is hostile to you, the Lumeri Church first. Allied Blessings on you fail on a 1–2 on a d6.

traits.name: Gambler
traits.flavour: The house always wins. You are not the house, and you've never once let that stop you.
up: Double or Nothing: once per scene, declare "double" before a d20. A success becomes a critical success; a failure becomes a critical failure.
down: In Debt: you owe the Smetanita Conjunction. Their collectors turn up when the Narrator decides.

traits.name: Insomniac
traits.flavour: Sleep is for people without a watch rotation.
up: Always Up: you can't be ambushed while the squad rests, and you take a watch with no penalty.
down: Wired: resting restores only half your HP and mana.

traits.name: Chain Smoker
traits.flavour: Smoke break. Now. The Orks can wait.
up: Light Up: 2 AP: +2 Composure for the scene and remove one Heart Debuff.
down: Hacking Cough: −1 Athletics. Enemies smell you coming: +2 to their Detection against you.

traits.name: Live to Fight Another Day
traits.flavour: Brave is a word they carve on headstones.
up: Tactical Withdrawal: Retreat and Disengage cost 0 AP, and you get +2 Dodge while retreating.
down: Yellow: allies within 3 tiles take −1 on Fear saves. It's contagious.

traits.name: Sworn Sibling
traits.flavour: Blood, oath, or something stronger. Where they go, you go.
up: Bound: while adjacent, the two of you share one free AP per round. You always know where they are.
down: Bound: if they go down, you must reach them. Until you do, every attack and skill roll that isn't moving you toward them, healing them or defending them is at −2, and moving away from them costs double. HP, damage and other combat stats aren't affected.

traits.name: Rival
traits.flavour: Jealous? Why would you be jealous? Completely ridiculous.
up: Show-Off: after your rival succeeds at something, your next roll on that same skill gets +2.

Neck and Neck: whenever your rival reaches a new level, you gain 50 XP; while your rival is a higher level than you, you get +10% XP from every source except Essence. It works both ways: the same goes for your rival.
down: Petty: helping your rival (handing them AP, healing, giving cover) takes a Camaraderie check first.

traits.name: Humanity First
traits.flavour: The stars belong to humankind. Robots are tools, Crawlers are vermin, and anything from the upper realm is the enemy.
up: For Humanity: +15% damage against non-humans (robots, Crawlers, Orks, upper-realm beings) and +2 on saves against their Fear effects.
down: Xenophobe: you can't use Empathy, Charisma or Camaraderie with non-humans. Non-human squadmates can't hand you AP, and their heals work at half power on you.

traits.name: Wanted
traits.flavour: Your face is on a poster in every Central City precinct, and it's a bad likeness.
up: Notorious: +2 Intimidation with the underworld; start with one piece of contraband.
down: Bounty: bounty hunters appear when the Narrator decides, and Central City officials start hostile.

traits.name: Company Man
traits.flavour: Rigaz Trade Company (RTC™®). The card has no limit. The contract does.
up: Company Card: buy gear from RTC at cost. Once per campaign, RTC extracts you from anywhere.
down: Contract: RTC sends you jobs. You can't refuse one without breaking the contract, and RTC remembers.

traits.name: Field Medic
traits.flavour: You learned triage under fire, in a medical unit where the casualty rate was the point.
up: Triage: healing an ally costs 1 AP less. Once per combat, you can heal a downed ally up to 3 tiles away with a thrown stim.
down: First, Do No Harm: on a turn when an ally within 5 tiles is below a quarter of their HP, you can't attack until you've healed someone.

traits.name: Squad Anchor
traits.flavour: Someone has to hold the line so everyone else can move.
up: Hold Fast: allies within 2 tiles of you get +1 on all saves and +1 Dodge. If you don't move this turn, the range becomes 3 tiles.
down: Fixed Point: on a turn you move more than 2 tiles, the effect drops and you lose 1 AP next turn.

traits.name: Born Officer
traits.flavour: A commission, a bloodline, or just the voice. When you speak, soldiers move.
up: Command: once per round, spend 1 AP to give an ally a free 1 AP move or attack. Your Leadership rating counts one step higher.
down: The Squad Leans on You: if you're downed or out of sight, allies within 5 tiles lose 1 AP next turn. Taking an order from anyone else takes a Composure check.

traits.name: Cold Case
traits.flavour: The CCEC washed you out, or you walked. Either way, you never stopped working cases.
up: Case File: the Analyze action costs 1 AP less. Once per session, after investigating a scene, ask the Narrator one yes-or-no question about whoever is responsible. The answer is true.
down: Obsession: while a case is open, −1 on every roll in scenes that have nothing to do with it.

traits.name: Interrogator
traits.flavour: Central Command taught you the quiet room. You still know where every bone in the hand is.
up: The Quiet Room: alone with a captive, +2 on Intimidation and Eloquence. A captive you break gives one true answer they'd never give anyone else.
down: Known Trade: civilians who learn what you do start at −2 Charisma and Empathy with you.

traits.name: Trench Poet
traits.flavour: You can't say anything plainly. Plain words are for orders and obituaries.
up: Verse: once per scene, answer in metaphor. The listener rolls Implication against your Implication; on a fail, they take a Heart Debuff (Confused). Allies who hear you get +1 Composure for the scene.
down: Nothing Straight: giving a plain, direct answer takes an Eloquence check.

traits.name: Grudge Bearer
traits.flavour: You remember every slight. You've written most of them down.
up: Spite: Debuffs you inflict last 1 extra round, and the first one each combat skips the target's save.
down: Never Forgive: when someone wrongs you, the Narrator marks them. Until you get even, −2 on rolls that don't target them.

traits.name: Crowded Head
traits.flavour: Every skill in your head has an opinion, and none of them wait their turn.
up: Chorus: up to 4 voice lines per beat instead of 2, and you can Ask a skill twice per scene instead of once.
down: Cacophony: resisting an Overreach costs 1 more Echo, and once per session the Narrator may turn one of your voice lines misleading, even when the hook was true.

traits.name: Market Blood
traits.flavour: You grew up behind a stall in Mandestra. You can price a man by his boots.
up: Haggle: buy at −20% and sell at +20%. Touch any item to learn its true value, and whether it's fake.
down: Price on Everything: giving away an item or accepting a gift takes an Analysis check: you can't stop pricing it. −1 Camaraderie.

traits.name: Cover Story
traits.flavour: You've sold the same bridge in four systems, under four names.
up: New Name: once per session, set up a false identity in one sentence. NPCs accept it until you fail a roll in front of them.
down: Paper Trail: the Narrator tallies every identity you burn. At 3, someone from an old con turns up.

traits.name: Inner Ring Heir
traits.flavour: Old money from Central City's inner ring. Your family name opens doors, and paints a target.
up: Allowance: start with triple funds. Once per session, call in a favour from the family.
down: The Name: every enemy of your house knows you, kidnappers included, and you can't refuse a family summons.

traits.name: Slicer
traits.flavour: You started out cracking bank cards in Central City. You graduated to doors, cameras and turrets.
up: Backdoor: 2 AP: take control of one electronic device within 5 tiles (door, camera, turret) for a round, on a Proficiency check against its tier.
down: Jacked In: your implant makes EMP and lightning stun you for 1 turn, and machines spot you more easily: +2 to their Detection against you.

traits.name: Demolitionist
traits.flavour: Every problem is a load-bearing wall.
up: Shaped Charge: set an explosive as a 2 AP action and choose the blast's shape: line, cone or circle. +30% explosive damage.
down: Ringing Ears: −2 Vigilant, and any check that depends on hearing fails.

traits.name: Drone Handler
traits.flavour: It's small, it's loud, and it's the only one in the squad that never complains.
up: Little Friend: start with a drone: 30 HP, 3 AP of its own, scouts or carries 5 kg. Proficiency repairs it.
down: Tethered: if the drone is destroyed, you take a Heart Debuff until you rebuild it, which takes a rest and materials.

traits.name: Augmented
traits.flavour: Part of you came out of a catalogue.
up: Chrome: pick one augment at creation. Arm: +20% Physical Damage. Eye: +2 Vision Range and sight in darkness. Legs: +1 Movement and jumps of up to 2 tiles.
down: Maintenance: after each rest, make a Proficiency check; on a fail, the augment doesn't work the next day. EMP disables it for 2 turns.

traits.name: True Believer
traits.flavour: Holy Father Nerukhan, or some other saint, has never once let you down. You've never once let them down either.
up: Unshaken: Blessing cooldowns are 1 turn shorter. Once per session, your prayer is answered: the Narrator grants a small miracle.
down: Rites: keep your church's daily rites (dawn prayer, fasting days). Each day you can't, −1 Faith and Will Power until you make amends.

traits.name: Heaven's Faithful
traits.flavour: The Department fights Heaven. You pray to it. If they ever find out, they'll shoot you.
up: Communion: once per scene, ask your twin soul in the upper realm one question. The Narrator answers truthfully, but in riddles. +2 Outburst Range.
down: Treason: if the Department learns your faith, you're hunted. Each time you fight upper-realm beings, make a Faith check or hesitate and lose 2 AP.

traits.name: Occultist
traits.flavour: The Institute of Forgotten Knowledge lent you one book. You never gave it back.
up: Forbidden Text: start with a grimoire. Once per session, learn any supernatural creature's weakness. Out of combat, you can spend 10 minutes warding an area against the supernatural.
down: Overdue: the Institute wants its book back. The book talks too: once per session, the Narrator whispers you one false line through it.

traits.name: Crawler-Blooded
traits.flavour: Your grandmother crossed the line at Daggerfall. Her blood still shows under your skin.
up: Chitin: 30% less limb damage taken. You can climb walls at half Movement, and Crawlers never attack you first.
down: Marked: humans who see your blood start hostile. Lumeri Blessings burn you for 10 damage before they take effect.

traits.name: Old Timer
traits.flavour: You were already old when Daggerfall happened.
up: Seen It All: start each session with 1 extra Echo (2). Once per session, declare you've seen this before: one Rumination, Lore Master or Analysis check succeeds automatically.
down: Old Bones: −0.5 Movement and −10% max HP. Without a full night's rest, −2 on every Body skill the next day.

traits.name: Pacifist
traits.flavour: You won't kill. Not even them.
up: Sanctuary: while you haven't attacked this combat, enemies get −2 to hit you. Every attack you make can be nonlethal, and enemies you defeat that way surrender to a talk at +3. Mercy earns you double Karma.
down: The Vow: if you kill, lose all your Echo and take a Heart Debuff for the rest of the session.

traits.name: Moon Hunter
traits.flavour: You tracked game across three moons before you ever tracked a man.
up: Tracker: follow any trail less than a day old. Your first attack on a creature you tracked this scene does +30% damage.
down: Wild Born: in cities, −2 Charisma, Eloquence and Authority.

traits.name: Beast Handler
traits.flavour: It came to you half-starved. Now it would die for you, and nearly has.
up: Companion: a trained beast fights at your side: 60 HP, 4 AP of its own, bite and grapple. It obeys your Empathy checks.
down: Bond: if it dies, you take a Heart Debuff for the rest of the campaign arc. It can't enter most buildings in Central City.

traits.name: Ace Pilot
traits.flavour: Give you anything with an engine and you'll find out what it can really do.
up: Born Behind the Stick: you can drive or pilot anything with an engine. Vehicles you drive get +1 Movement, and use your Dodge.
down: Grounded: after a full day on foot, −0.5 Movement and −1 Reaction Speed until you're back in a seat.

body: Muscle, blood, and how well you command your own flesh.
Runs on ammo, weapons and tech
mind: The brain: absorbing theory and thinking logically.
Burns mana cores to draw Sigils
soul: The heart: emotional awareness and social perception.
Spends mana on Soul spells and prayer

ults.name: War Footing
ults.flavour: The Hellraisers call it marching on the enemy's nerves.
ults.text: Your threats never backfire: a failed Intimidation check costs you nothing. Any enemy that ends its move in the 3×3 around you loses 2 AP immediately.

ults.name: Last Charge
ults.flavour: Every army has a song for running at guns. You know all of them.
ults.text: After charging an enemy from 7 m or more, gain a shield of 15 × your Armour Class (at least 15) for one turn. Melee hits made during the charge deal 1.5× base melee damage.

ults.name: Angel of the Trenches
ults.flavour: The 258th Medical Unit's highest honour has no medal. The soldiers just say your name.
ults.text: Once per combat, when an ally within your Movement would drop to 0 HP, move to them and stabilise them out of turn, for 0 AP.

ults.name: Every Lie Is a Door
ults.flavour: You don't break in. You get invited.
ults.text: Once per session, walk into any guarded place by naming a reason to be there. You're believed until someone draws a weapon.

ults.name: Twin Discipline
ults.flavour: The Science Team says it can't be done. The Institute says it shouldn't be. You do it anyway.
ults.text: Fuse a Sigil and an Outburst into one cast: the Sigil's words set where it reaches and what it covers, the Outburst sets the school. Pay both costs.

ults.name: Supreme Command
ults.flavour: Five stars, and nobody looks you in the eye.
ults.text: Once per combat, give one order to the whole squad. Every ally takes a free 2 AP action immediately.
